name: Morenatsu. (Hikoushikihan)
source:
2019 fan project that adds a route for Torahiko to Morenatsu. This project was released anonymously, featuring a completed route for Torahiko along with new sprites, characters, and cgs.

[From [url=https://morenatsu.fandom.com/wiki/Torahiko%27s_Unofficial_Route]Morenatsu Wiki[/url]]
translation:
2019年粉丝项目，增加了虎彦到莫奈津的路线。该项目以匿名方式发布，其中包含虎彦的完整路线以及新的精灵、角色和CG。

[来自[url=https://morenatsu.fandom.com/wiki/Torahiko%27s_Unofficial_Route]Morenatsu Wiki[/url]]
